title: 002 眼前一亮
content_zh:
夫妻宫位于面部的眼睛尾部，也就是我们通常所说的鱼尾纹的地方。如果鱼尾部位光鲜饱满，则夫妻和睦，而凹陷，黯淡无光，则是丧偶的表象。

唐振东对于这些相术的东西，很是精通，不过缺少实战罢了。而且唐振东也没打算把这个作为一个职业，很多时候，唐振东在卖水果的间隙，总是匆匆瞅两眼，从而简单的看看人世间的旦夕祸福。

不过唐振东对于老叶邀请自己跟他一起干，的确是没大有兴趣。应该说是兴趣是有，但是对于骗人他没兴趣，起码心里会不安。

唐振东是有真本事的人，他的风水相术源于知识，他的师父曾告诉过他：从事风水相术这一行的人，总逃不脱五弊三缺。

所谓五弊三缺，就是这一行当的人，总有不圆满的地方，或者短命，或者丧偶，或者遭受天堑，或者无法聚财等等。

唐振东曾经问他的师父你的五弊三缺是什么？师父指了指他处身的这片监狱，“我的五弊三缺就是牢狱之灾。”

虽然唐振东不知道师父在这座监狱多少年了，但是他估计，师父在里面呆的时间绝对少不了。

唐振东对于天意，不敢揣测，也根本无法抗拒。天道循环，报应不爽。

“抱歉，老叶，我感觉还是卖水果有安全感。”

听到唐振东这么说，老叶也没说什么，人各有志。虽然他看好唐振东的淳朴憨厚，但是却不会低三下四的求他给自己当徒弟。虽然说徒弟能抢了师父的饭碗，但是徒弟也能帮师父不少忙。

老叶看好唐振东的一点就是唐振东机警、变通，而且还长了一张非常让人容易相信的脸。

可别小看这张脸，这张脸就是出门看风水最佳的通行证。有的人，让人一见，就心底生出一种熟悉和信任。而有些人即使说的是实话，那他的面相也会让人凭空的生出怀疑。

都说相有心生，人的相貌在长时间的心理形成的过程中，会被心理不自觉的改变，这种改变是潜移默化的，不是一时半会就能看的出来的。但是我们在社会上行走，有的人让人一见就生出一种亲近感，有的人则让人一见就生厌，这就是相由心生。

唐振东就长了这么一副人见人爱，花见花开，车见车爆胎的这么一张取巧的脸。说是比较帅，但是乍看又比较大众化。要说大众化，细端量又很帅。可以说上到九十九，下到刚会走，这都是唐振东这张脸能沟通的范围，让人一见既惊叹帅气，又有一种似曾相识的感觉。

虽然唐振东拒绝了老叶做他风水相术学徒的说法，但是这并不影响唐振东和老叶之间的交情。

“小唐，今天去我家吧，咱们一起喝一杯？做了一年的邻居，也没请你到家喝一杯，正好今天我闺女放暑假回来，我闺女烧的菜那简直是一绝，特意请你品尝下。”

不管老叶在算命摊前怎么忽悠，那其实都是为了生活，其实在唐振东心中，老叶这个人是非常不错的。先不说他那张平易近人总是露出笑容的脸，就说他的脾气也是极好，这一年两人相邻摆摊的时候，唐振东就从来没见过老叶红过脸，整天一副笑眯眯的模样。

“不了，我还是回去自己凑合点就行，女儿回来了，还是你们一家人团聚下吧。”

“别，别，以前我不叫你，是因为我手艺不行，其实我早就想叫你一起喝一杯了，这次我闺女回来，她做饭保准你吃了一次还想吃第二次。”

“那我就更不能去了，这家伙，要吃了一次还想吃第二次，那岂不是我天天都要忍不住去你家吃饭？”唐振东哈哈大笑。

老叶也笑了，“你即使天天吃，也吃不穷我。”

唐振东仔细的看看老叶，问，“老叶，你不是准备招我当上门女婿吧？”

老叶连连摆手，“去，去，去，我闺女可是京城大学的高材生，她将来要留在京城的，不可能。”

唐振东能听得出来，老叶的意思是自己一个卖水果的小商贩，根本就配不上自己的女儿，而且人家闺女将来毕业了是要留在京城的。

即使听到了老叶这么说，唐振东也不生气，自己本来就配不上人家，他有自知之明，更何况自己还在监狱服刑过，这事自己可没跟老叶说，即使人家老叶不知道自己有过服刑的经历，那自己一个高中肄业生，也根本配不上人家京城大学的高材生。

唐振东的高中只上过半年，就因为失手杀人，而进入监狱，这一呆就是八年。八年对于一个十七岁的青年来说，可以说青春的最好的一段时光都是在监狱中度过的。直到二十五岁，唐振东出狱。其实唐振东在里面获得了好几次减刑的机会，但是他都放弃了，因为什么？因为他的师父也在监狱，并且一直都在。

不过老叶不管唐振东怎么说，非要拉着唐振东一起回家吃饭。大概是刚才老叶也意识到了自己的话，可能触动了唐振东的伤处。其实老叶早就看出唐振东是个有故事的人，虽然唐振东总是一副人畜无害的笑嘻嘻模样。

不过老叶并不会去轻易揭开唐振东的伤处，因为老叶自己就是个算命的，察言观色，了解人的思想。知道什么地方的伤能揭，什么地方的伤不能揭。

唐振东见老叶邀请的意思非常诚恳，也就同意了。不过他要先把自己的水果车，送回自己城乡结合部的出租房。

谁知道老叶非要去自己家认认门，唐振东不好说什么，毕竟人家请自己吃饭，要去自己认门，又不是去自己家蹭饭，拒绝的话，那就太没有人情味了。

“咦，这是你住的地方？”老叶从一进这个这个村。第一感觉就是脏乱差，唐振东租的这个房子位于幸福镇新建村，当然现在的幸福镇已经规划到了市里，早就改名幸福社区了，不过就是这么一个幸福社区，就是全市典型的脏乱差。

垃圾，污水，白色污染遍布整个社区。老叶在海城已经呆了好多年了，对于幸福社区的现状，他也了解。但是他的了解只是归于耳闻，但是今天来到幸福，这才真正目染。

不愧是“幸福”，这里的人可真“幸福”。

但是当老叶进入一处民宅，也就是唐振东租住的屋子的时候，他非常惊讶。不是说唐振东屋里装修多么多么豪华，多么多么的上讲究。相反唐振东租住屋的整个房子，也跟所有幸福社区的房子一样，老旧破烂，唐振东只是租住了这栋房子的一角的一个屋。

幸福镇的本地住户，大部分都不上班，而且这里早已经没有地了，全靠出租房子维生，这里的房子都是原本的平房，自己起的二层小楼，有的甚至搭了三层。一间房一百五到二百，连带着楼上楼下起码也有十间左右的出租房，这一个月光是租金，就差不多二千块。

有的做点小买卖，反正维持生计是没问题，够吃够喝了。

这里是城乡结合部，很多外来务工人员，都住这里，因为这里的房子便宜。幸福社区可以说是整个海城市人口最为密集的区域。

人口密集，再加上外地人口多，可想而知，这里的环境会怎么样。

老叶先前对幸福社区的脏乱差已经有了准备，但是一进入了唐振东租的这个屋子，立马感觉到明显的不同，眼前仿佛一亮。

但是仔细看来，却并没有什么不同，只是在屋里特别整洁而已。唐振东的屋里就一张床，上面整整齐齐的叠着被子，被子是叠的方方正正的豆腐块。

这其实是唐振东在监狱八年而练就的绝招，三秒钟之内，能把一床乱七八糟的被子叠成整齐的豆腐块。

在监狱，内务的整齐是进入监狱里面要学的第一课。
content_en:
The palace of husband and wife is located at the end of the eyes on the face, which is what we usually call crow's feet.If the fish tail is bright and full, it means the couple is in harmony; if it is sunken and dull, it means being widowed.

Tang Zhendong is very proficient in these physiognomy things, but he lacks practical experience.Moreover, Tang Zhendong did not intend to take this as a career. Many times, when Tang Zhendong was selling fruit, he would always take a quick look at it to simply see the blessings and misfortunes in the world.

However, Tang Zhendong was indeed not very interested in Lao Ye inviting him to work with him.It should be said that he is interested, but he has no interest in lying, at least he will feel uneasy.

Tang Zhendong is a man of real ability. His Feng Shui physiognomy comes from knowledge. His master once told him: People who engage in Feng Shui physiognomy can never escape from five disadvantages and three shortcomings.

The so-called five disadvantages and three shortcomings mean that people in this profession always have imperfections, such as short life, widowhood, suffering from natural disasters, inability to accumulate wealth, etc.

Tang Zhendong once asked his master what are your five shortcomings and three shortcomings?The master pointed to the prison where he was, "My five shortcomings and three shortcomings are the disaster of prison."

Although Tang Zhendong didn't know how many years Master had been in this prison, he estimated that Master would definitely spend a lot of time there.

Tang Zhendong did not dare to speculate on God's will, and he could not resist it at all.The cycle of heaven brings unfavorable retribution.

"Sorry, Lao Ye, I feel safer selling fruit."

Hearing what Tang Zhendong said, Lao Ye didn't say anything. Everyone has his own ambitions.Although he was optimistic about Tang Zhendong's simplicity and honesty, he would not ask him to be his apprentice in a lowly manner.Although the apprentice can steal the master's job, the apprentice can also help the master a lot.

What Lao Ye likes about Tang Zhendong is that Tang Zhendong is alert, flexible, and has a face that is very easy to trust.

Don't underestimate this face. This face is the best pass to go out and see Feng Shui.Some people create a sense of familiarity and trust in people's hearts as soon as they meet them.And even if some people are telling the truth, their appearance will make people suspicious out of thin air.

It is said that appearance comes from the mind. In the long process of psychological formation, a person's appearance will be psychologically and unconsciously changed. This change is subtle and cannot be seen in a short time.But when we walk in society, some people make people feel close to them as soon as they meet them, while others make people feel disgusted at the first sight.

Tang Zhendong has such a face that everyone loves, flowers bloom when flowers bloom, and cars have flat tires.It is said to be more handsome, but at first glance it looks more popular.In terms of popularity, it is slim and handsome.It can be said that from ninety-nine to just walking, this is the range that Tang Zhendong's face can communicate. It makes people marvel at his handsomeness at first sight, and also feel a sense of déjà vu.

Although Tang Zhendong rejected Lao Ye's proposal to be his Feng Shui physiognomy apprentice, this did not affect the friendship between Tang Zhendong and Lao Ye.

"Xiao Tang, why don't you come to my house today and let's have a drink together? I've been a neighbor for a year and I haven't invited you to my house for a drink. It just so happens that my daughter is back from summer vacation today. The food my daughter cooked is simply outstanding. I specially invite you to taste it."

No matter how much Lao Ye cheated in front of the fortune-telling stall, it was all for the sake of living. In fact, in Tang Zhendong's heart, Lao Ye was a very good person.Not to mention his approachable face that always showed a smile, his temper was also very good. When the two of them set up stalls next to each other this year, Tang Zhendong had never seen Lao Ye blushing and smiling all day long.

"No, I'll just go back and make do on my own. Now that my daughter is back, it's time for you and your family to get together."

"No, no, I didn't call you before because I wasn't good at cooking. In fact, I've wanted to ask you to have a drink with me for a long time. This time my daughter comes back and she will cook something that you will want to eat a second time."

"Then I can't even go. This guy wants to eat a second time after eating it once. Doesn't that mean I can't help but go to your house to eat every day?" Tang Zhendong laughed.

Lao Ye also smiled, "Even if you eat every day, you won't be able to feed me."

Tang Zhendong looked at Lao Ye carefully and asked, "Lao Ye, are you planning to recruit me as your son-in-law?"

Lao Ye waved his hands repeatedly, "Go, go, go. My daughter is a top student at Beijing University. It is impossible for her to stay in Beijing in the future."

Tang Zhendong could tell that Lao Ye meant that he, a small fruit vendor, was not worthy of his daughter, and that his daughter would have to stay in the capital after graduation.

Even after hearing what Lao Ye said, Tang Zhendong was not angry. He was not worthy of him in the first place. He was self-aware, not to mention that he had served a sentence in prison. He did not tell Lao Ye about this. Even if Lao Ye did not know that he had served a sentence, then he, a high school dropout, was not worthy of a top student of Beijing University.

Tang Zhendong only attended high school for half a year before he went to jail for accidentally killing someone. He stayed there for eight years.Eight years, for a seventeen-year-old young man, it can be said that the best part of his youth was spent in prison.Until the age of twenty-five, Tang Zhendong was released from prison.In fact, Tang Zhendong had several opportunities to reduce his sentence, but he gave up because of what?Because his master is also in prison and has always been there.

But no matter what Tang Zhendong said, Lao Ye insisted on taking Tang Zhendong home for dinner.Probably Lao Ye just realized that his words might have touched Tang Zhendong's wounds.In fact, Lao Ye has long seen that Tang Zhendong is a man with a story, although Tang Zhendong always smiles like a harmless person.

However, Lao Ye would not easily uncover Tang Zhendong's injuries, because Lao Ye himself was a fortune teller, able to observe words and emotions and understand people's thoughts.Know where the wounds can be healed and where the wounds cannot be healed.

Tang Zhendong saw that Lao Ye's invitation was very sincere, so he agreed.But first he had to take his fruit cart back to his rental house in the urban-rural fringe area.

Who knew that Lao Ye would have to go to his own house to acknowledge him? It was hard for Tang Zhendong to say anything. After all, he was being invited to a meal, so he had to acknowledge himself instead of going to his own house for dinner. It would be too impersonal to refuse.

"Hey, this is where you live?" Lao Ye entered this village from the first moment.The first impression was that it was dirty and messy. The house Tang Zhendong rented was located in Xinjian Village, Xingfu Town. Of course, Xingfu Town has been planned in the city and has long been renamed Xingfu Community. However, it is such a happy community, which is typical of the city's dirty and messy environment.

Garbage, sewage, and white pollution are all over the community.Lao Ye has stayed in Haicheng for many years, and he also understands the current situation of Xingfu Community.But his understanding was only due to hearing, but today when he came to happiness, he really saw it.

It is indeed "happy", the people here are really "happy".

But when Lao Ye entered a private house, the house where Tang Zhendong rented, he was very surprised.It's not that the decoration in Tang Zhendong's house is so luxurious and exquisite.On the contrary, the entire house where Tang Zhendong rented a house was, like all the houses in the Happy Community, old and dilapidated. Tang Zhendong only rented a corner of the house.

Most of the local residents in Xingfu Town do not work, and there is no land here. They rely on renting out houses to make a living. The houses here are all original bungalows, two-story buildings built by themselves, and some even have three floors.A room costs 150 to 200 yuan, and there are at least about ten rental rooms upstairs and downstairs. This monthly rent is almost 2,000 yuan.

Some do some small business, but they can make ends meet anyway, as they have enough to eat and drink.

This is an urban-rural fringe area, and many migrant workers live here because the houses here are cheap.Xingfu Community can be said to be the most densely populated area in Haicheng City.

With the dense population and the large number of people from other places, you can imagine what the environment here will be like.

Lao Ye had been prepared for the messiness of Xingfu Community before, but as soon as he entered the house rented by Tang Zhendong, he immediately felt an obvious difference and his eyes seemed to light up.

But if you look closely, there is no difference. It's just that the room is very neat.There is only one bed in Tang Zhendong's room, with a quilt neatly folded on it. The quilt is made of square tofu blocks.

This is actually a trick that Tang Zhendong has mastered after eight years in prison. Within three seconds, he can fold a messy quilt into neat tofu pieces.

In a prison, keeping the house tidy is the first lesson to be learned when entering the prison.
